project_info.theme: YSL The Slim bold product packshot campaign
project_info.color_palette: Ruby red, metallic gold, black, warm coral

main_subject.detail: A dramatic vertical product packshot of multiple YSL The Slim lipsticks arranged like a sculpture against a faceted red-and-gold geometric background. At the bottom the text reads 'SHOOT FOR THE STARS' and 'THE SLIM'.
main_subject.style: High-gloss luxury product sculpture, fashion-beauty still life, bold geometric glamour

composition_elements.text: SHOOT FOR THE STARS; THE SLIM
items: Top Left: Angled illuminated red-gold geometric planes
Top Right: Glittering red starfield-like background texture
Bottom Left: Horizontal lipstick casings stacked as a base
Bottom Right: Large cream text 'SHOOT FOR THE STARS' and 'THE SLIM'
Center/Background: Multiple YSL The Slim lipsticks standing vertically and diagonally in a sculptural arrangement

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Metallic reflections, sharp edge highlights, dramatic shadow depth, glam campaign shine

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality vertical luxury beauty packshot for YSL The Slim. Centerpiece is a sculptural arrangement of multiple YSL The Slim lipsticks in black and gold casings against a faceted ruby-red and metallic-gold geometric background. Include the exact text 'SHOOT FOR THE STARS' and 'THE SLIM' at the bottom. Technical style: photoreal luxury product still-life composite, high-gloss product studio lighting, metallic reflections and dramatic glam-campaign depth, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
